name: Same Sex Marriage
overview: Scripture clearly defines marriage as a union between a man and a woman, as seen in Genesis 2:24 where a man leaves his parents and cleaves to his wife to become one flesh. The Old Testament laws in Leviticus 18:22 and 20:13 explicitly forbid sexual relations between men, labeling such acts as abominations with severe consequences. Additionally, Deuteronomy 22:5 condemns cross-dressing as abominable to God, underscoring the importance of distinct gender roles. The narrative in Genesis 19:1 and the vivid imagery in Ezekiel 23:20 further illustrate God's disapproval of sexual immorality, reinforcing a biblical standard for marriage and sexual conduct rooted in holiness and order.
